description: I am a 3rd-year B.Tech Computer Science Engineering student with an interest in programming, technology, and problem-solving. I have basic knowledge of Java and C programming and am eager to learn new technologies, improve my technical skills, and gain practical experience. I am looking for motivated and collaborative team members who are interested in learning, sharing ideas, developing projects, and working together to achieve our goals.
summary: This project demonstrates an AI-based butterfly system developed using MATLAB Simulink. It uses a simulated butterfly as the input source, followed by signal processing through a Signal Duty block. The processed signals are connected to an AI chip and a TX & RX communication system. The model also includes coil connections and a battery-motor section. The main objective is to demonstrate the integration of artificial intelligence, signal processing, communication, and electronic components in a single simulation model. This project explores how these technologies can work together in an integrated system.
details:
To integrate different electronic components into one model.

To observe system signals using MATLAB Simulink.

Technologies Used

MATLAB Simulink

Artificial Intelligence (AI)

Signal Processing

TX & RX Communication

Electronic Circuit Simulation

Expected Outcome

The model provides a simulation-based demonstration of how different electronic and AI-related components can be connected and work together as an integrated system.

Overall, our project focuses on combining AI, electronics, and simulation technology to explore innovative engineering applications.
